{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Roger Ross Williams (born September 16, 1973) is an American television news, documentary and entertainment director, producer and writer.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" He directed most notably \"Music by Prudence\" that won the Academy Award for Best Documentary (Short Subject), about a 21-year-old Zimbabwean singer-songwriter Prudence Mabhena, who was born severely disabled and has struggled to overcome poverty and discrimination.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" All other seven members of Prudence's band \"Liyana\" are also disabled.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Williams's film \"God Loves Uganda\", which premiered at the 2013 Sundance Film Festival to enormous critical acclaim.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" It was shortlisted for a 2014 Academy Award, has won over a dozen awards and screened at over 60 film festivals worldwide.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" His latest film \"Life, Animated\" was nominated for the 2017 Academy Award.","title":"Roger Ross Williams"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Mathilde Bonnefoy (born 11 March 1972) is a French film editor and director who was nominated for an ACE Eddie Award for the editing of the film \"Run Lola Run\" (1998) and who won the award for editing the documentary \"Citizenfour\" (2014).","title":"Mathilde Bonnefoy"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" She and her husband Dirk Wilutzky additionally served as producers of \"Citizenfour\" with its director Laura Poitras, and the three received the 2014 Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature.","title":"Mathilde Bonnefoy"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"What 2014 Academy Award winner guest starred in \"Emanuelle Goes to Dinosaur Land?"}
